notes: Researched 2026-11-14 by the pricing agent. SAM'S CLUB: 'listed' prices were read that day from samsclub.com listing/product pages (the url on each entry is the exact page). They are Sam's ONLINE prices for its default club; samsclub.com says 'prices may vary in club and online' (a spot check on the Addison #6487 club page showed one egg item ~3% higher than the default online price). Where a temporary 'Instant Savings' price was shown, the regular price is used and the sale is noted in the label. Per-pound meat (chicken trays, ground beef rolls, pork) uses Sam's average package price and average weight (price ÷ $/lb). Sam's bakery brands differ by region (e.g., buns), so Addison may stock a different budget brand. Some Sam's tiers have no national brand online (fresh meat, eggs, produce, spices); those 'name' entries repeat the store-brand item or a premium Member's Mark item and say so. JEWEL-OSCO: jewelosco.com blocks automated reading and needs a chosen store, and Instacart pages for Jewel are closed to automated reads, so every Jewel number is 'estimated'. Anchors: Jewel-Osco listings on DoorDash (Nov 2026; sizes usually not shown, and delivery-app prices can run above in-store, so these lean slightly high on purpose), a GroceryChop scrape of a Jewel regular price, and typical late-2026 Chicago-area Albertsons/Jewel shelf prices for Signature Select/Signature Farms/Lucerne/O Organics vs national brands. Treat Jewel estimates as about ±15%, and expect weekly-ad sales (e.g., chicken breast $1.99-2.49/lb) to beat them. Produce is unbranded, so both tiers match. Items in 'notSeenAt.sams' were not found on samsclub.com and have no Sam's entry here; Sam's entries whose label says 'NOT seen on samsclub.com' are planning estimates for products Sam's commonly carries. v2.1 lunch products (catalog ids with "lunch": true) were researched the same way on 2026-11-14 evening; their Jewel prices are estimates too, and Boar's Head items are Boar's Head in both tiers because that is what Knox asked for. The family can correct any price in-app.

conversions.rice: dry long-grain rice ≈ 2.3 cups per lb (≈ 197 g per cup)
conversions.liquids: 1 fl oz = 2 tbsp = 6 tsp; 1 gallon = 16 cups = 256 tbsp; 32 fl oz broth = 4 cups
conversions.tacoSeasoning: ≈ 7.5 g per tbsp (a 1 oz packet ≈ 4 tbsp)
conversions.groundSpices: black pepper / paprika ≈ 2.3 g per tsp; cumin ≈ 2.1 g; garlic powder ≈ 3.1 g; crushed red pepper ≈ 1.8 g
conversions.driedLeafHerbs: oregano / Italian seasoning ≈ 1 g per tsp
conversions.salt: table/fine sea salt ≈ 6 g per tsp
conversions.counts: garlic ≈ 10 cloves per bulb, ≈ 5 g per peeled clove; navel orange ≈ 8 oz; lemon ≈ 4 oz; lime ≈ 2.4 oz; sandwich loaf 20 oz ≈ 20 slices; potstickers ≈ 0.8 oz each
conversions.canEquivalents: pineapple and pork-and-beans sizes are expressed in the catalog's can size (20 oz / 28 oz) when Sam's sells smaller cans

notSeenAt.note: Not found on samsclub.com on 2026-11-14 (frozen corn/peas, coleslaw mix, tikka sauce, cornstarch, sesame oil, smoked paprika, canned carrots, ground pork, rice & cider vinegar, flour, panko, brown sugar, hoagie rolls, frozen mini corn cobs, edamame, cilantro). Lunch items: Sam's has no Boar's Head deli counter or Boar's Head snack trays online, no Orange Mango-only BODYARMOR pack (only variety packs), no Taylor Farms single-serve bowls and no ranch dip cups. Plan these at Jewel-Osco unless the family confirms the Addison club stocks them.
